row_15_override.reason: Row 15 fired on amendment count, but D1 established that the failures being counted were specification defects in drafting, not method failures. Recorded so it is not read later as a rule quietly abandoned.
row_15_override.returns_to_force: on completion of this amendment; a third amendment is a hard stop, not a document to be written

supersedes: A10b.1 C2 bandwidth restriction (superseded only if the A2-T6 prediction holds)

a2_t3_block_rule.rule: block length = h / block_ratio, no floor
a2_t3_block_rule.note: A2-T3. Not in force until Cooper responds to the A2-T2 decision point.

a2_t4.reason: 10 us sits 10.61 rungs below the bandwidth sweep floor of 2^-6 s. Struck, not relaxed and not moved. Do NOT extend the sweep downward to reach it.
a2_t4.consequence: The time-rescaling method has no validated recovery of a microsecond-scale cluster and cannot be read as evidence about the fragmentation scale. Its validation rests on C4 and C4' only.

a2_t6.prediction: C2' excursion band centre moves DOWN ~2 rungs from C2's 128-1024 s.
a2_t6.falsification: Band stays at 128-1024 s, or moves in the wrong direction, or does not move.
a2_t6.real_data_counterpart: none -- on a real event there is no known injected timescale, so no rung may be excluded on this basis outside the controls

a2_t2c_usability_criteria.survival_test: the first two rows; failing either means the knee is unusable and Phase 10b reports a method limitation

offline_validation_triad: single-rung reduction to the ordinary Monte Carlo rank p-value, exact identity, 200 cases
p-value uniformity under the null across the whole range, not merely the tail
type I error on C1 within [0.02, 0.10] over 200 independent datasets

n_knee_draws_note: A2-T1 refits the knee on independent realizations of each control. 500 puts the standard error of the 2.5/97.5 percentiles well under a tenth of a rung, the resolution A2-T1b reports at. Not a gate threshold; carried forward from config/phase_10b_diagnostic_1.json.
modifies: No value in config/phase_10b.json or A10b.1 is modified by this file; A2-T3's floorless block rule is recorded here and takes effect only when A2-T3 runs.
